note: Small campground on a bend of the Greenbrier River in Alderson, on the Alderson side of the 'new bridge'; the owners live on site. An RV-only campground: tents only beside a registered RV, for an extra fee. Campers more than 20 years old must describe their exterior and electrical condition when registering. --Claude

Note cleaned of fields' facts and the RV Life line. Operator's 'ALL sites are Riverfront' agrees with the riverfront value.
